rules.title: Security Deposit Limits and Handling
rules.requirement: The maximum security deposit cannot exceed one and one-half times one month's rent. The landlord must hold the security deposit in trust and may not commingle it with personal funds. Interest earned on the deposit belongs to the tenant and must be paid or credited annually. The landlord must return the security deposit plus interest within 30 days after tenancy termination, less lawful deductions, and provide an itemized list of deductions if any.
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord can only ask for a security deposit up to 1.5 times your monthly rent, must keep it in a special account, pay you interest on it, and return it within 30 days after you move out, minus any damage costs.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador solo puede pedir un depósito de seguridad hasta 1.5 veces su renta mensual, debe mantenerlo en una cuenta especial, pagarle intereses y devolverlo dentro de 30 días después de que se mude, menos los costos por daños.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to most residential rental properties, including mobile homes, except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings unless tenant opts in after 30 days written request.
rules.exemptions_text: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt unless tenant opts in.
rules.penalty: Landlord who willfully withholds security deposit from tenants receiving government assistance may be liable for civil penalties from $500 to $2,000 per offense. Unlawful use of security deposits may result in criminal charges and fines or imprisonment.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum-security deposit to be collected by the landlord cannot be more than one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ). ... The security deposit money continues to be the property of the person making the deposit and must be held in trust by the person receiving the money. ... The interest or earnings paid on the security deposit belongs to the tenant and shall be paid to the tenant in cash or credited toward rent due and owing on the renewal or anniversary of the tenant’s lease ... Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit, plus interest earned less deductions, to the tenant ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.1).
